name: IC Analog — 3.3V, 5V, SPI — TSSOP
description: Surface-mount analog IC cluster supporting 3.3V and 5V supply facets with SPI communication in TSSOP-16 package format.
selection_hints: Require an analog IC with SPI interface operating at 3.3V or 5V.
Targeting surface-mount designs using a TSSOP-16 footprint.
Prefer tier A KiCad analog parts such as ADC1283.
avoid_when: The PCB design requires a package type other than TSSOP.
The application does not use SPI communication or 3.3V/5V supply levels.
Through-hole mounting or non-analog IC functionality is needed.
